collection.title: SEAT Arosa 1997 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The SEAT Arosa 1997 to 2004 model requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Arosa, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
